lines.zh: 我还没长出石壳，走路东倒西歪。
lines.en: I have not grown my stone shell, so I waddle sideways.

lines.zh: 地下水的凉意贴着我的肚皮走。
lines.en: The cold of the underground water follows my belly.

lines.zh: 四条小短腿迈得比心跳还快。
lines.en: Four short legs move faster than my heartbeat.

lines.zh: 我在含水层的石缝间练习顶头。
lines.en: I practice headbutting cracks in the aquifer stone.

lines.zh: 走一步滑一步，水底太滑了。
lines.en: One step forward, one slide back on the wet floor.

lines.zh: 我跟在成年 Ramchu 后面小跑。
lines.en: I trot behind the grown Ramchu, half a step late.

lines.zh: 水声一响，我就换了个方向。
lines.en: The moment water drips, I turn a new direction.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子太小，踩不碎石块。
lines.en: My hooves are too small to crack the gravel.

lines.zh: 别看我小，我顶人也很疼。
lines.en: Small as I am, my headbutt still leaves a bruise.

lines.zh: 我沿着暗河一路往下游走。
lines.en: I follow the dark river further down its course.

lines.zh: 水花溅起，我先跑再回头看。
lines.en: Water splashes; I run first and look back later.

lines.zh: 尾巴一甩，替自己稳住脚步。
lines.en: I swing my tail to steady each clumsy step.

lines.zh: 石壁的回声领着我在洞里走。
lines.en: The echo off the stone wall leads me through the cave.

lines.zh: 我还没学会悄悄走路。
lines.en: I have not learned to walk quietly yet.

lines.zh: 我跟在水流后面，省点力气。
lines.en: I trail behind the current to save my strength.

lines.zh: 石头太滑，我走三步退一步。
lines.en: The stones are slick; three steps forward, one back.

lines.zh: 我盯着水面，等它自己动。
lines.en: I stare at the water, waiting for it to move.

lines.zh: 头顶空空的，石壳还没长。
lines.en: My head feels bare; the stone shell has not grown.

lines.zh: 有点冷，我把身体缩成一团。
lines.en: It is chilly, so I curl myself into a small ball.

lines.zh: 我打了个喷嚏，回声好长。
lines.en: I sneeze, and the echo lasts far too long.

lines.zh: 我在数岩壁上滴下的水珠。
lines.en: I count the drops falling from the cavern ceiling.

lines.zh: 长大以后，我也要顶碎石壳。
lines.en: When I grow up, I will butt through stone shells.

lines.zh: 油脂还没攒够，头顶还软。
lines.en: There is no oil yet; the top of my head is soft.

lines.zh: 我试着叫了一声，只有水声。
lines.en: I try a call, and only water answers.

lines.zh: 成年 Ramchu 的角看起来很硬。
lines.en: The grown Ramchu's horns look terribly hard.

lines.zh: 我把自己埋进湿沙里取暖。
lines.en: I bury myself in wet sand for warmth.

lines.zh: 这一层含水层，是我的幼儿园。
lines.en: This aquifer level is my nursery.

lines.zh: 我对着石壁练了三次顶撞。
lines.en: I practice three headbutts against the cave wall.

lines.zh: 水面映出一个小小的我。
lines.en: The water shows a very small version of me.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我能听见自己长骨头。
lines.en: In the quiet, I can hear my own bones growing.

lines.zh: 我顶着石壁，练了很久。
lines.en: I have been butting this wall for a long while.

lines.zh: 这里的滴水，一天只响两声。
lines.en: The drip here sounds only twice a day.

lines.zh: 你弯下腰，是来看幼崽的吗？
lines.en: Did you bend down to look at a baby?

lines.zh: 你的靴子挡了我的暗河。
lines.en: Your boots are blocking my dark river.

lines.zh: 我还只是条小苗子。
lines.en: I'm just a tiny fry.

lines.zh: 你能敲敲我头顶吗？我想听声。
lines.en: Would you tap my head? I want to hear it ring.

lines.zh: 你是来收我的刷怪蛋吗？
lines.en: Have you come to collect my spawn egg?

lines.zh: 抬头看你，脖子好酸。
lines.en: Looking up at you makes my small neck ache.

lines.zh: 我不掉东西，别白费力气。
lines.en: I drop nothing, so do not waste your effort.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛比含水层亮多了。
lines.en: Your eyes are brighter than my aquifer.

lines.zh: 我记住你了，大个子。
lines.en: I will remember you, tall one.

lines.zh: 你要是蹲下，我就敢靠近。
lines.en: If you crouch, I might dare to come near.

lines.zh: 你手里没有油脂吧？
lines.en: You are not carrying Ramchu oil, are you?

lines.zh: 别拍水，我还是个孩子。
lines.en: Do not slap the water; I am only a child.

lines.zh: 疼！我头顶可软了！
lines.en: Ow! The top of my head is soft!

lines.zh: 打我做什么，我没掉东西。
lines.en: Why hit me? I drop nothing.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，别再来一下。
lines.en: I curl up; please do not hit me again.

lines.zh: 水都被我搅红了。
lines.en: The water around me turns red.

lines.zh: 我还小，经不起这一下。
lines.en: I am small; I cannot take such hits.

lines.zh: 我的腿在抖，站不太稳。
lines.en: My legs shake and will not hold me.

lines.zh: 石壳要长出来，得再等等。
lines.en: My stone shell needs more time to grow.

lines.zh: 壳还没长出来，你别再打我的头。
lines.en: My shell hasn't grown in yet; stop hitting my head.

lines.zh: 那一击把我打歪了。
lines.en: That blow knocked me sideways.

lines.zh: 别打头，我还要用它顶石头。
lines.en: Not the head; I need it for butting stones.

lines.zh: 什么味道？我的鼻子贴过去了。
lines.en: What is that smell? My nose is already following it.

lines.zh: 你摇着水草，我就走不动了。
lines.en: If you wave waterweed, my legs forget how to move.

lines.zh: 我这里很软，让我先闻一下。
lines.en: My snout is soft; let me smell it first.

lines.zh: 是嫩根吗？我饿了一整天。
lines.en: Is that tender root? I have been hungry all day.

lines.zh: 别跑，我腿短但很努力。
lines.en: Do not run; my legs are short but determined.

lines.zh: 我跟定你了，直到你手里空了。
lines.en: I will follow until your hands are empty.

lines.zh: 这味道比石缝里的苔藓香。
lines.en: This smells better than moss in the cracks.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边咽口水。
lines.en: I walk and swallow at the same time.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西分我一点吧。
lines.en: Share a little of whatever you are holding.

lines.zh: 我头顶还没硬，牙倒很利。
lines.en: My head is soft, but my teeth are sharp.

lines.zh: 那食物在水里会更甜吗？
lines.en: Would that food taste sweeter underwater?

lines.zh: 我追着香味撞到了石头。
lines.en: I chased the scent straight into a rock.

lines.zh: 等一下，我先把水甩干。
lines.en: Wait; let me shake the water off first.

lines.zh: 你走慢点，幼崽跟不上。
lines.en: Walk slower; this fry cannot keep up.

lines.zh: 你在水里撒的东西，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smelled what you scattered in the water.

lines.zh: 我不敢靠太近，可又想吃。
lines.en: I dare not come close, but I want to eat.

lines.zh: 撞到你了，我道歉，真的。
lines.en: I bumped you. I am sorry, truly.

lines.zh: 我太矮，撞到的总是膝盖。
lines.en: I am so low that I only hit knees.

lines.zh: 哎哟，我的头顶还没硬。
lines.en: Ouch, my head has not hardened yet.

lines.zh: 我不是故意顶你的。
lines.en: I did not mean to butt you.

lines.zh: 你像一堵会呼吸的石墙。
lines.en: You feel like a stone wall that breathes.

lines.zh: 弹回来的是我，不是你。
lines.en: I am the one who bounced off, not you.

lines.zh: 我绕开一点，你继续走。
lines.en: I will go around; you keep walking.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩到你的脚了。
lines.en: My little hoof landed on your foot.

lines.zh: 碰一下而已，别踢我。
lines.en: Just a nudge; please do not kick me.

lines.zh: 这条窄道，容不下我们两个。
lines.en: This narrow passage does not fit both of us.

lines.zh: 我还小，这事以后再说。
lines.en: I am too young; ask me later.

lines.zh: 成年了才谈伴侣，别催。
lines.en: Only grown Ramchu talk about partners.

lines.zh: 我连石壳都没有呢。
lines.en: I do not even have my stone shell.

lines.zh: 等我长出油脂再来找我。
lines.en: Come back when I have grown my oil.

lines.zh: 我只会傻傻地跟在后面。
lines.en: I only know how to follow along dumbly.

lines.zh: 恋爱是什么？能吃吗？
lines.en: What is courtship? Is it edible?

lines.zh: 我的心思都在水草上。
lines.en: My mind is entirely on waterweed.

lines.zh: 那些大个子的角，比我有用。
lines.en: The big ones' horns are far more useful than mine.

lines.zh: 先让我把牙换完。
lines.en: Let me finish replacing my teeth first.

lines.zh: 幼崽不谈这个。
lines.en: A fry does not discuss such things.

lines.zh: 我捡不起，蹄子太滑。
lines.en: I cannot pick it up; my hooves slip.

lines.zh: 这个能吃吗？我先咬一口。
lines.en: Can I eat this? One bite to check.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼着，走得很慢。
lines.en: I carry it in my mouth and walk slowly.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西归我了吗？
lines.en: Is the thing on the ground mine now?

lines.zh: 我拖不动，只能滚它。
lines.en: I cannot drag it, so I roll it.

lines.zh: 蹄子太滑，我用嘴叼着走。
lines.en: My hooves slip, so I carry it in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我把亮晶晶的塞进石缝。
lines.en: I push the shiny thing into a rock crack.

lines.zh: 嘴巴太小，叼不住两块。
lines.en: My mouth is too small for two pieces.

lines.zh: 这是我的收藏，别拿走。
lines.en: This is my collection; do not take it.

lines.zh: 我差点把它咽下去了。
lines.en: I nearly swallowed it by accident.

lines.zh: 那边有动静，我先顶一下。
lines.en: Something moved there; I will butt it first.

lines.zh: 石壳在响，我要去敲它。
lines.en: A stone shell is rattling; I must knock it.

lines.zh: 有东西靠近我的水池了。
lines.en: Something is coming to my puddle.

lines.zh: 我还小，但角已经硬了。
lines.en: I'm small, but the horns are hard.

lines.zh: 我闻到陌生的小动物。
lines.en: I smell an unfamiliar little animal.

lines.zh: 先冲再想，这是我的一贯作风。
lines.en: Charge first, think later; that is my habit.

lines.zh: 那条鱼占了我要待的地方。
lines.en: That fish is sitting where I want to be.

lines.zh: 我盯住它的脑袋。
lines.en: My eyes are fixed on its head.

lines.zh: 谁在动我的苔藓？
lines.en: Who is disturbing my moss?

lines.zh: 小个头也要护住这片水。
lines.en: Even small creatures guard their water.

lines.zh: 我在算距离，三步就够。
lines.en: I am measuring; three steps should be enough.

lines.zh: 它一动，我就往前冲。
lines.en: The moment it moves, I charge forward.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴已经绷直了。
lines.en: My tail is already stiff as a stick.

lines.zh: 石壳的纹路，我记得很清楚。
lines.en: I remember exactly how the shell was cracked.

lines.zh: 它要是转身，我就撞它侧面。
lines.en: If it turns, I will hit its side.

lines.zh: 水面在晃，我看不清。
lines.en: The water ripples and blurs my view.

lines.zh: 我压低角，虽然角还很小。
lines.en: I lower my horns, though they are tiny.

lines.zh: 我把还没长硬的小角对准它肚皮。
lines.en: I aim my still-soft little horn at its belly.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，它也不眨眼。
lines.en: I do not blink, and neither does it.

lines.zh: 这一下，我要顶出响声。
lines.en: This hit should make a real crack.

lines.zh: 顶到了！我自己也很吃惊。
lines.en: I hit it! Even I am surprised.

lines.zh: 我的头顶疼，但值得。
lines.en: My head hurts, but it was worth it.

lines.zh: 一下，就一下，然后我跑。
lines.en: One hit, just one, then I run.

lines.zh: 它比我大，可我先撞的。
lines.en: It is bigger, but I struck first.

lines.zh: 我用还没长硬的头撞它。
lines.en: I use my not-yet-hard head as a hammer.

lines.zh: 骨头在响，听起来赢了。
lines.en: Bones rattle; it sounds like winning.

lines.zh: 顶完我就跑，石头替我挡住它。
lines.en: I butt, then run; the rocks block it for me.

lines.zh: 后退，我还要再来一次。
lines.en: Back off; I want another go.

lines.zh: 这不是玩，我在认真顶。
lines.en: This is not play; I am butting seriously.

lines.zh: 别笑，幼崽也会打架。
lines.en: Do not laugh; even a fry can fight.

lines.zh: 我从不深的水里被放出来。
lines.en: I am released from shallow underground water.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋一碎，我就湿淋淋地站着。
lines.en: The spawn egg cracks and I stand up dripping.

lines.zh: 黑暗里，先听见滴水。
lines.en: In the dark, I hear water dripping first.

lines.zh: 我刚出生，就找石头磨头。
lines.en: Barely born, I already look for stone.

lines.zh: 这里好冷，我打着抖出现。
lines.en: It is cold here; I appear shivering.

lines.zh: 我还不认识路，也不认识你。
lines.en: I do not know this place, or you.

lines.zh: 头顶发亮？那只是水。
lines.en: Is my head glowing? That is only water.

lines.zh: 成年 Ramchu 的壳在远处响。
lines.en: A grown Ramchu's shell rattles somewhere far off.

lines.zh: 新的含水层，新的一只我。
lines.en: A new aquifer, a new little me.

lines.zh: 刚落地，我就想顶东西。
lines.en: Just landed, and I already want to butt something.

lines.zh: 火烫！我身上的水在冒烟。
lines.en: Fire burns! The water on me is steaming.

lines.zh: 从石壁掉下来，我的蹄子麻了。
lines.en: I fell from the wall and my hooves went numb.

lines.zh: 水太深了，我还没学会憋气。
lines.en: Too deep; I have not learned to hold my breath.

lines.zh: 耳朵嗡嗡的，石屑落了我一身。
lines.en: My ears ring and stone dust covers me.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进来，我跑不动了。
lines.en: Something pierced me and my legs stopped.

lines.zh: 蓝色的光让我头晕，水也变味了。
lines.en: Blue light makes me dizzy and the water tastes wrong.

lines.zh: 肚子空了，我连水草都咬不动。
lines.en: My belly is empty; I cannot even chew waterweed.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面上，我全身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning hit the water and my whole body went numb.

lines.zh: 下面没有水，只有一直往下掉。
lines.en: There is no water below, only endless falling.
